title: South Korean Instagram accounts with verifiable India travel — what we can prove
topic: South Korean public figures on Instagram with evidence of visiting India
audience: Someone building a verified list — not a hype ranking
governingThought: A rigorous “top accounts in Korea who’ve been to India” list cannot be ranked from public web search alone — but several verified Korean actors posted India content on official Instagram accounts corroborated by multiple news outlets.
takeaways: **[@m.m.minki](https://www.instagram.com/m.m.minki/)** (Lee Min-ki) posted India travel content captioned “Varkala. Tiruvannamalai.” — reported by [News18](https://www.news18.com/movies/korean/south-korean-star-lee-min-ki-savours-cone-dosa-chai-and-temple-visit-during-south-india-trip-9779472.html), [Mathrubhumi](https://english.mathrubhumi.com/movies-music/news/south-korean-actor-lee-min-ki-kerala-trip-flbi0eaj), and [Deccan Chronicle](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/entertainment/dosas-and-yoga-south-korean-star-lee-min-ki-vacations-in-south-india-1926428).

**[@hajiwon1023](https://www.instagram.com/hajiwon1023/)** (Ha Ji-won) posted India/Kerala content while filming MBC’s *Massage Road* — reported by [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/web-series/news/korean/korean-star-ha-ji-won-of-secret-garden-fame-in-india/articleshow/113293219.cms) and [India Today](https://www.indiatoday.in/entertainment/ott/story/korean-actor-ha-ji-won-shares-instagram-photos-from-india-trip-fans-excited-2598735-2024-09-12) (Sep 2024).

A defensible **“top by followers”** ranking was **not produced** — Instagram’s explore/search APIs and follower counts were not accessible in this research pass; see Method section for what would count as proof.
meceMap: What would count as proof next time

blocks.text: The brief asked for **top Instagram accounts in South Korea** whose **public posts show India travel**. That requires (a) a complete or sample-biased crawl of Korean Instagram by follower count, (b) geotag or visual verification per post, and (c) stable public access to those posts.

blocks.title: Kill criterion triggered
blocks.text: Without authenticated Instagram search, follower rankings are [unverified]. Web search surfaces **news-covered celebrity trips**, not a statistically sound “top N.” Publishing a fabricated top-10 would violate this project’s kill criteria.

Instagram location search and follower-sorted people search require logged-in sessions and return incomplete results to automated tools. Third-party “top influencer” lists often omit verification links.
These entries meet the bar: **official account named in reputable press** + **press describes Instagram posts showing India** + **link to account URL**.

rows: Posts from Varkala (Kerala) & Tiruvannamalai (Tamil Nadu): dosa, temple, yoga
Kerala/Kovalam posts, kasavu saree, beach with locals; filming *Massage Road*
Same India shoot; press photos reference shared Instagram content

blocks.text: Lee Min-ki’s agency [Sangyoung ENT warned](https://www.mk.co.kr/en/hot-issues/11481142) that impersonation accounts exist — only the **official public profile** counts. Fan sites ([AsianWiki](https://asianwiki.com/Min-gi_Lee)) list **@m.m.minki** as his Instagram.
Co-traveler Instagram handles for Ahn Jae-hong / Kim Dae-ho were **not** verified in primary press to the same handle-level standard — omitted rather than guessed.

items: Query: Korean celebrity + India + Instagram (English and Korean keywords).
Require ≥2 independent news outlets citing Instagram posts, or 1 tier-1 outlet + official show documentation.
Reject influencer marketing lists without primary post links.
Attempt Instagram location explore for “India” — blocked without login; logged result as inconclusive.

sections.title: What would count as proof next time

items: **Post-level URL** (instagram.com/p/…) archived on [Wayback Machine](https://web.archive.org/) showing geotag or caption naming an Indian locality.
**Location tag** on the post matching a Google Maps place in India.
**Follower rank** from Instagram’s category search with screenshot + date, or licensed social-data provider with methodology disclosed.
**Minimum N** — e.g., top 10 by followers among accounts with ≥1 archived India post in the last 24 months.
